title: Frequently asked questions

items.question: Is Lovart a Shopify app or a design workflow?
items.answer: This demo presents Lovart as an AI design agent workflow for Shopify teams. It creates and edits assets used on Shopify stores and acquisition channels; it is not positioned here as a Shopify admin plugin.

items.question: What inputs should a Shopify team upload?
items.answer: Useful inputs include SKU photos, packaging art, brand guidelines PDFs, existing ads, PDP screenshots, customer reviews, product specs, competitor URLs and channel requirements.

items.question: Can Lovart create product images for PDP and ads?
items.answer: Yes. The relevant workflow combines Image Generator, Remove BG, Mockup, Edit Elements and Brand Kit to create PDP hero shots, clean product images, lifestyle scenes, comparison visuals and ad crops.

items.question: How does Lovart help conversion beyond image generation?
items.answer: Lovart keeps offer, audience, brand and product context alive across landing pages, PDP modules, ads, emails, social content, retargeting and localization. That continuity is what makes it a design agent rather than a single-output generator.

items.question: Can teams edit sale copy and localized text inside generated assets?
items.answer: Yes. Text Edit is designed for changing copy inside generated visuals while preserving the original font style, layout and visual treatment.

items.question: What is the role of Thinking Mode and Fast Mode?
items.answer: Thinking Mode is best for structured launch strategy, product positioning and campaign systems. Fast Mode is best for exploring many hooks, styles and A/B creative variants quickly.

items.question: Does this page still show all component variants?
items.answer: Yes. The original /all route still keeps the same component coverage and anchor structure, but the examples are now rewritten around the Shopify ecommerce conversion scenario.

items.question: How much does Lovart cost?
items.answer: Lovart starts free (100 credits/mo). Paid plans from $10/mo include more credits, premium models, and commercial licensing.
